lina: FYI during int6 tempesta bringup we hit a small but noisy regression in multiorient subtitle smoke: ZWJ/ZWSP/parenthesis placement changes in CJK vertical + RTL samples. repro below. :mag:
sam: can you share the exact eval command and a short failing snippet?
lina: command: `rrun eval --model=tempesta-v2-int6 --suite=multiorient_subs --subset=zh_vertical,hebrew_rtl --shards=1 --jobs=4 --log-token-ids`

summary (small run):
``
zh_vertical: BLEU 31.4 -> 24.9 (regressions 96/300)
hebrew_rtl: bracket-orient flips baseline=0 -> 18/300
```

lina: minimal zh example input: "（海戶）
"
baseline detok tokens: ["（","\u6d77\u6236","\uff09"]
int6 detok tokens:   ["（海戶）"]  # opening bracket glued to ideograph

hiro: do token ids differ? could be tokenizer change or post-detok insertion of ZWJ/ZWSP.
lina: token_ids are identical in the failing shard. attaching snippet: `token_ids=[210,4392,77]` for both compaction on/off, but render differs.

amin: identical ids implies downstream shaping/layout or hidden-state-sensitive detok. did int6 flip any ICU/Unicode lib or change ZWJ insertion heuristic?
tess: packaging only changed per-head quant-folding and a new kvcache compaction heuristic + packed-attn-quant kernel. no ICU bump. suspect compaction causes slight hidden-state drift -> shaping differences.
sam: try `--no-kvcache-compaction --stable-quant` A/B.

lina: ran A/B: compaction off + stable-quant -> zh regressions 8/300, hebrew flips 0/300. compaction on alone reduces but still >15 flips.

hiro: suggests compaction timing amplifies quant rounding causing different implicit insertion/omission of ZWJ or reordering in bidi pass. can we diff per-token hidden states and Bidi bracket classes?

amin: I ran a token-level hidden diff for the offending prefix: small L2 delta (~1e-3) but attention mass on the opening bracket token shifts ~12%. that could change whether we emit an explicit joiner during detok.

lina: wrote a tiny failing file `/evals/smoke/multiorient/zwj_bidi_repro_1745557777.txt` and a render under `/evals/smoke/renders/1745557777/`.
sre-bot: canary job scheduled: tempesta-int6-zwj-canary #84211 (compaction=false)

tess: next actions: 1) add a locale-focused smoke to CI (zh vertical + hebrew paren check), 2) gate aggressive kvcache compaction for mixed-orientation inputs, 3) add a build flag `quant-stability` to force deterministic folding during early bringups, 4) open BR ticket and bisect packed-attn-quant kernel.

lina: filing BR-1312 with logs and small render. will ping UX/docs for render screenshots. thanks :sparkles:
